# Typerite

> The easiest way to write is to let something think for you. This is the other way.

## What is Typerite?
Typerite is a daily writing practice built around a blank page and a set word goal. No prompts. No templates. No AI suggestions.

## Who is it for?
- Writers, students, and knowledge workers who want to think clearly through daily writing.
- People who want a ritual of deliberate, manual writing without AI assistance.

## Core Philosophy
- **Earned Words**: Only words you type count. Paste is disabled.
- **No AI, No Prompts**: Just a blank page and a cursor.
- **Restoration**: If you miss a day, you can restore your streak by writing more the next day.
- **Privacy**: All writing is stored locally on your device and encrypted. No analytics, no tracking.

## Platforms
- iOS
- iPadOS
- macOS

## Pricing
- $24.99 per year
- 30 days to practice before paying
- Write for 365 consecutive days and the next year is free

## Data handling (summary)
- Writing is stored locally on your device (encrypted) and on secure servers to sync across devices.
- Writing is never used for advertising or AI training and is not shared with third parties.
